body:
Maya: Quick sync — i'm wondering if we should formalize a 'sideband prefetch' pattern in the SDKs to reduce tail latency for paged endpoints that also need aggressive retries.
Jon: define sideband prefetch? like fetch next page in parallel while consuming current?
Maya: yup. but the tricky bit is retry semantics + idempotency. if we prefetch page N+1 and client cancels, we wasted tokens + it complicates retries when server returns transient 5xx for N+1.
Li: also language ergonomics differ. TS async iterators make it easy to prefetch; python generator + sync iterator less so, and go channels add goroutine complexity.
Sam: dug into numbers — for our main list endpoint prefetching next page drops p99 latency by ~120ms at moderate concurrency but increases token usage ~8%. tradeoff seems acceptable for hosted tier, sketchy for Dedicated where cost predictability matters.
Maya: good context. i think we need a surface that: (a) opt-in in SDKs, (b) gives policy knobs: prefetch window size, max inflight prefetched pages, and retry isolation.
Jon: policy idea: when prefetching, label requests with a sideband id so server logs can correlate; SDK should treat prefetch failures as non-fatal by default unless user opts into strict mode.
Li: opt-in default for TS/py = off for now? or on for hosted but off for Dedicated/private? 
Sam: i'd prefer default off. users who care about p99 can enable. less surprise.
Maya: agreement. next: retry isolation — if prefetch fails with 5xx should we retry with backoff separate from foreground page? my vote: isolated retry with exponential backoff + cap, and don't block foreground consumption.
Jon: +1. also implement a fast-fail path: if prefetch gets 429, backoff but try again later; if 5xx then try once more quickly then give up. configurable.
Li: ergonomics: expose a small Opts object on the iterator: e.g. 
```
client.listItems({pageSize:100}).withPrefetch({window:1, maxInflight:2, retryPolicy:"isolated"})
```
that way TS stays fluent. python could be 
```
for page in client.list_items(page_size=100, prefetch=Prefetch(window=1, max_inflight=2)):
    ...
```
Go: provide functional option on iterator constructor.
```
// go example
it := client.ListItems(ctx, opts.WithPrefetch(Prefetch{Window:1, MaxInflight:2}))
```

Sam: important: telemetry. we need per-iterator counters: prefetched_pages, prefetch_failures, prefetch_waste_count, and p99 delta. console should show cost delta per-customer when prefetch enabled.
Maya: agree. action items: 1) spec API shapes for TS/py/go (Li/Jon) 2) runtime retry policy knobs (Sam) 3) opt-in defaults and docs blurb for Hosted vs Dedicated (Maya) 4) add metrics hooks (Sam).
Jon: i'll draft TS api today and post PR for shape. will include example and tests simulating mid-stream cancel.
Li: i'll do python iteration surface and a small shim to keep sync generator ergonomics.
Sam: i'll prototype retry isolation state machine and add metrics counters.
Maya: deploy-bot: bump: design-triage scheduled for tomorrow 10am PT.
deploy-bot: Meeting created: design-triage — 2026-03-22 10:00 PT (link: https://meet.example/rtc/abc123)
Jon: thanks — i'll bring concrete code sketch.
Li: sounds good. one more thought: make the prefetch idempotency token optional so server can drop duplicate work for prefetched pages when it sees the same token later. could reduce wasted compute.
Sam: server-side dedup is cool but requires server support. add as advanced opt.
Maya: ok let's keep that as optional server-assisted optimization. good thread. :thumbsup:
thread_text_snippet: sideband prefetch pattern, SDK surfaces, retry isolation, metrics, action items
